name: Adafruit ESP32-S3 Feather (4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM)
description: Dual-core ESP32-S3 Feather with native USB, Wi-Fi 4 + BLE 5, 4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM, LiPo charger with fuel gauge and STEMMA QT with switchable power.
notes: MAX17048 battery fuel gauge on I2C; STEMMA QT power is switched by GPIO7 (I2C_POWER) for low-power sleep.
Native USB: hold BOOT while pressing RESET for the ROM/UF2 bootloader.
A cheaper 8 MB flash / no-PSRAM variant (product 5323) uses the same headers.
Header pin 'DB' is the debug UART TX (GPIO43). Frequently out of stock at Adafruit.
